adaptive_native_simulation.strategy: Frame-locked raster near 0/180 degrees; 8x8 tiles otherwise. Sixteen direct-mapped cache lines; eight-row raster reorder buffer.

physical_rotation_comparison.limits: Finite physical tests with different camera scenes. Per-angle cycles are medians of UART observations, not scene-independent benchmarks. CF counts newly completed corrected frames; HDMI PF includes repeated refreshes. Temperature uses the uncalibrated internal ADC. No simulated results are included.

twelve_angle_numerical_audit.limits: Dense software coordinate audit against the fitted fisheye2 model at 640x480, including fixed-point rotation and Brown surrogate. Only rays inside the established radial bound count toward numerical error. Masking and source-edge black pixels are reported separately. This is neither a new optical measurement nor 12-angle full-frame RTL coverage; existing native RTL coverage remains six angles. No new calibration or high-resolution proof.

short_burst_native_simulation.limits: Isolated six-angle full-frame RTL with sealed real camera sources and synthetic DDR stalls. Byte/CRC output is unchanged. Eight-beat controller compatibility, complete camera/HDMI arbitration, timing, physical bandwidth and FPS remain unverified. This is not an active board target.

paired_cache_native_simulation.strategy: Direct computed-line tag check, paired horizontal neighbors from one synchronous RAM beat, 32 cache lines with 8-beat bursts; raster near 0/180 and tiles otherwise.
paired_cache_native_simulation.limits: Six native frames and 2322 independent query oracles, plus small three-clock camera/DDR/HDMI test with mixed 8/16-beat reads, ownership, CRC, malformed-response and reset checks. Synthetic DDR model; not a board target. Controller compatibility, routed timing, physical bandwidth, FPS and temperature still require validation.

pipeline_hit_native_simulation.strategy: Four synchronous read replicas, two-stage elastic hit pipeline. A miss drains prior hits before the unchanged serial 8-beat fallback; frame handshake invalidates both caches. Raster near 0/180, tiles otherwise.
pipeline_hit_native_simulation.limits: Synthetic DDR and six real-source golden frames; not an achieved physical FPS. The 1-cycle interval applies only to resident hits with ready output. Misses and image order still limit throughput. Logical RAM capacity is calculated, not mapped resources. Four-way address/tag logic and RAM replicas need board mapping, routed timing, controller compatibility and temperature checks. No active board target was changed.

pipeline_twelve_native_simulation.limits: Twelve full-size RTL frames using two sealed real-camera inputs, frame-locked settings, independent integer interpolation, all DDR beats and CRCs, synthetic stalls and immutable source checks. Six prior angle oracles retain matching CRCs. Numerical and RTL correctness only; optical accuracy, higher resolution, actual DDR throughput and finite physical stability remain separate evidence.

bounded_model_candidate.limits: Isolated coefficient candidate for the existing fitted fisheye2 lens, K, radial guard and third-order Brown datapath. Linear programming minimizes sampled continuous radial coordinate error; dense tests include current fixed-point rotation/quantization. It does not prove a continuous-domain supremum, optical accuracy, new RTL outputs, timing or physical image improvement. No calibration data, active include, board sources or archived golden outputs were changed. Separate candidate vectors/RTL and held-out physical poses are required before adoption.

higher_resolution_requirements.next_architecture_need: Coordinate math already accepts a ray each enabled cycle. The isolated replicated hit pipeline now supports one resident query per cycle, while misses and image order still determine whole-frame cost. Higher resolution needs controller/bandwidth and physical timing/resource validation, more cache locality, new camera mode and bank geometry. More camera fps alone does not establish the target.
higher_resolution_requirements.limits: Budgets are arithmetic requirements, not achieved hardware performance or sensor maximum ratings. DVP byte-clock minima exclude blanking; actual camera mode, clock electrical limits and FPGA timing must be verified. VGA cycles must not be extrapolated into a claimed higher-resolution fps. 1080p requires new bank geometry, camera mode/intrinsics, HDMI timing and complete timing/optical checks.

limited_physical_straightness.method: OpenCV findChessboardCornersSB, fixed 9x6 inner-corner topology; independent total-least-squares fit to each of 6 rows and 9 columns. 108 point-to-line distances per image. Native-pixel and spacing-normalized results are both reported.
limited_physical_straightness.limits: A limited fresh physical pose, not a multi-pose or cross-lens optical acceptance. Corner localization, printed-board flatness, low resolution and resampling affect this straightness metric. New images are not automatically independent of the calibration pose distribution. This capture uses the previously validated zero-rotation corrected_capture binary, not the new overlap/adaptive board candidates.

physical_straightness_diagnostic.method: BGR image decode then cvtColor(BGR2GRAY), matching the main straightness evaluator. 54 raw corners are analytically transformed by the fitted fisheye model with P=K, then their row/column straightness is compared with raw corners and independently detected FPGA-output corners. Alternate direct grayscale decoding is reported separately as a localization sensitivity check.
